project.name: dubaipoints
project.productType: UAE travel, cards and loyalty editorial publication with financial decision tools

motion.existing: Native WAAPI Tween/useFlip with reduced-motion support; homepage scroll-loaded reel
motion.new: Restrained feedback; no autoplay rails or hidden-until-animation body copy

design.density: Open editorial reading with compact, explicit decision controls

preferredPrimitives: Existing Astro components and Preact islands

must: Keep the production homepage unchanged until owner selects a rendered direction; homepage redesign and animation are now permitted in private review prototypes
Preserve all financial data, calculation/ranking logic, URLs, sources and visible image credits until a separately reviewed correction is implemented
Light/dark, responsive, keyboard, touch, reduced-motion and no-JS fallbacks
Retain Salary Tracker one-band-or-all selection and independent multi-select offer filters
No production release before owner sees the light/dark previews
No secrets, paid provider generation or newsletter restoration
avoid: Unselected palette/font swap in the delivered site; exploration is allowed but is not approval
Autoplay offer carousels, cursor effects and heavy 3D
Duplicate TOCs or inaccessible custom controls
Copying code with unresolved licence or demo imagery
Fabricated figures, testimonials, audience numbers or approval guarantees

decisions.decision: Owner directed implementation of the researched 21st shortlist. Adapt patterns in-house across templates; research report and catalogue are references, not source-copying clearance. Preserve approved Runway/Cool Editorial interiors, Newsreader/Geist and protected homepage. Stage for owner previews before release.
decisions.source: Mostafa: Do it all; 21st resource research report in the current project conversation

decisions.decision: Owner reopened the whole site, including homepage and animation, for review and prototype exploration. This supersedes the protected-homepage constraint for candidates, not for production delivery. No new palette, font or direction is selected and no redesign release is approved.
decisions.source: Mostafa: Do a whole review. We can change if we want even the home page. Animation
